title: Phobig Vertigo and Dizziness. Bridging the Neuro-Psychiatric Gap: Diagnostic and Therapeutic Challenges in Phobic Postural Vertigo (PPV)
summary: Background: Phobic Postural Vertigo (PPV)—now broadly subsumed under persistent postural-perceptual dizziness (PPPD)—represents one of the most common causes of functional dizziness encountered in clin-ical practice. Positioned precisely at the intersection of neurology and psychiatry, PPV challenges conven-tional dichotomous thinking regarding organic versus psychogenic disorders.
